title: Quant calibration gate orchestrator for FP8/INT8 validation
creator: Riley Chen
description: Build an orchestrator service and CI job that runs multi-seed, stratified golden-prompt validations for FP8 and INT8 quantization profiles. The orchestrator will: (1) select and shard golden prompt stratifications by domain and difficulty, (2) run calibrated inference across target model/quant profiles with multiple random seeds and synthetic perturbations, (3) compute aggregated metrics (accuracy deltas, token-level perplexity, calibration drift) and apply adaptive pass/fail gates, and (4) publish triaged failures with suggested rollback or follow-up calibrations. The goal is to automate the gate that prevents low-quality quant releases while keeping false positives <5% and CI runtime within our build budget.
acceptance_criteria: Orchestrator runs end-to-end in CI for a sample model and two quant profiles (FP8, INT8) without manual steps
Adaptive gate evaluates aggregated metric set and emits PASS/FAIL with explainability details for failed prompts
False positive rate of gate on historical validation set <= 5% (measured over 3 months of historical runs)
Complete run for target model under budget: wall time < 45 minutes on CI runner equivalent
Triage artifact generated linking failing prompts to top-3 likely causes and suggested next actions
test_plan: Seed corpus: 6 stratified golden-prompt buckets (conversational, code, math, summarization, instruction-following, edge-cases)
For each bucket run 3 random seeds and 2 synthetic perturbations (typos/paraphrase) per prompt
Compute metrics: top-k exact-match, ROUGE-L, token-level perplexity delta, embedding cosine stability, and calibration shift (expected vs actual confidence)
Run baseline (FP32) and compare quant profiles to baseline; compute absolute and relative deltas
Validate gate thresholds on historical archived runs and tune adaptive threshold model (quantile-based)
rollout_plan: Phase 1: Internal CI only — run on sample models and iterate on metrics instrumentation (2 weeks)
Phase 2: Expand to full model catalog for nightly runs; require manual review for initial 10 FAILs/day (2 weeks)
Phase 3: Enable auto-blocking gate for release pipeline with alerting + on-call triage playbook (after observed stability)
Fallback: auto-enable safe-quant variant (higher precision) for any release blocked by gate until triage completes
metrics_thresholds: Mean exact-match drop <= 0.5% absolute vs FP32 baseline (primary metric for classification-like prompts)
ROUGE-L relative drop <= 1.0% for summarization prompts
Gate fail if 3+ buckets exceed thresholds or single critical prompt fails with high severity

notes: Trade-offs: heavier sampling reduces false negatives but increases CI cost; adaptive thresholds mitigate but require stable historical data
Design decision: use aggregated multi-seed median rather than mean to reduce sensitivity to outlier seeds
Potential risk: models with non-stationary behavior across contexts may require per-bucket thresholds; will monitor and add auto-slicing if needed
Follow-ups: expose per-model tolerances via model-catalog metadata and add webhook for product teams when gate blocks release
